tooltip = LOCALIZATION # optional, otherwise takes it from the message type

send_interface_message.raw_text:
send_interface_message - Sends a message to the player playing the character in the scope and then executes any effects inside.
For the message text and tooltip, $EFFECT$ contains the text description of the effects in the past tense.
And $DESC$ contains the text from the desc field.
send_interface_message = {
	type = message_type # default: send_interface_message
	title = LOCALIZATION # optional, otherwise takes it from the message type
	desc = LOCALIZATION # optional, otherwise takes it from the message type
	tooltip = LOCALIZATION # optional, otherwise takes it from the message type
	left_icon = scope:recipient # optional, character, artifact, title, dynasty, or house
	right_icon = scope:the_title # optional, character, artifact, title, dynasty, or house
		
	# optional effects...
	add_dread = 5
	scope:someone = { add_gold = 5 }
}
Supported Scopes: character

trigger_event.name: trigger_event
parameter_documentation: trigger_event = {
id = <event ID>                               # or:
on_action = <on_action name>                  # or:
saved_event_id = <event target with event ID> # example: scope:my_flag_name
trigger_on_next_date = "<year>.<month>.<day>" # trigger on a specific date in the future
trigger_on_next_date = "<month>.<day>"        # trigger the next time this date is reached (this or next year)
delayed = yes                                 # delay to the next tick
trigger_event.raw_text:
trigger_event - triggers an event or on_action
trigger_event = {
    id = <event ID>                               # or:
    on_action = <on_action name>                  # or:
    saved_event_id = <event target with event ID> # example: scope:my_flag_name
    
    # optionally, the event can be delayed via one of those choices:    days/months/years = <num>
    days/months/years = { <num> <num> }           # pick a value randomly from the range
    trigger_on_next_date = "<year>.<month>.<day>" # trigger on a specific date in the future
    trigger_on_next_date = "<month>.<day>"        # trigger the next time this date is reached (this or next year)
    delayed = yes                                 # delay to the next tick
}
Supported Scopes: none
